name: Apple

pros.title: brings a clean fruit identity
pros.explanation: It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite.

pros.title: easy to use as a whole food
pros.explanation: Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating.

pros.title: usually a strong swap for ultra-processed sweet snacks
pros.explanation: That replacement value is one of the most important practical reasons apples remain such a solid fruit baseline.

cons.title: satiety is not especially strong
cons.explanation: Fruit often needs help from the rest of the meal.

cons.title: best with something more filling
cons.explanation: It shines as part of a snack, not always as the whole snack.

cons.title: easy to eat quickly when it is very sweet
cons.explanation: That can blur the line between light and sugar-heavy portions.
